snippet.title: UNDERTALE: Cooking with Kindness Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
DEMO ON GAMEJOLT: https://gamejolt.com/games/cooking_with_kindness/900285 
TUMBLR: https://undertalecookingwithkindness.tumblr.com/

DEMO RELEASING ON GAMEJOLT ONTHE 16TH OF MAY

Undertale Cooking with Kindness is a prequel fangame focusing on the green SOUL, Sunny. Following their fall into the Underground, Sunny meets Luna, a monster with dreams of making the greatest restaurant in the underground. Determined to help, Sunny agrees to work together to achieve this far-off goal. 

In this unique UNDERTALE Prequel, experience gameplay like you've never seen before! Instead of battles, spend your days cooking food for customers at the Eclipse and try to make the greatest restaurant the Underground has ever known!

Luna voice: @LeaderFuzzy57 
Thumbnail art: Sockhead
Animation: Nikazio
Background help: Snrona
Trailer Editing: Doctorispie
Game made in Kristal
Full Team Credits on Gamejolt and Tumblr.
